notes: Now that cohorts are one coherent object, the attribution tool can finally read them. Until this release the price-identity attribution panel had a single known leg — the security's own substantiated value — and *everything* a name's cohort explained sat in the residual, undifferentiated from real idiosyncrasy. The decompose_price surface measured that cohort re-rating and reported it; the attribution panel never saw it, because the two were built on different substrates. On GOOG that left 61% of the price "unattributed" when a large part of it was simply the sector trading richly as a group.
